title: Station Information Snapshot
description: The normalized shape every source is mapped into, whatever its raw upstream form. This is the machine-readable twin of DataPacks/STATION_INFORMATION_SCHEMA.md (schema version 3). A producer outputs a `snapshot`; the on-device cache wraps it in an `envelope` (see $defs.envelope).
$comment: schemaVersion 3. The `source` field is an open string on purpose: adding a city (e.g. shanghaiMetroOnline) is additive and does not bump this schema. The authoritative list of valid source identifiers lives in ../sources/sources.json.

stationID.description: Canonical station ID, stable across releases. Keys into ../directory/directory.json.

stationName.description: Station name as the provider states it.

source.description: The source this snapshot was produced from. Must be one of the identifiers defined in ../sources/sources.json (e.g. beijingSubwayOnline, shanghaiMetroOnline, guangzhouMetroOnline, hongKongGovernment).

serviceDayNote.description: Which service day these times describe, in the source's own words, when it says. Hangzhou's payload is headed 工作日时刻表 — the weekday timetable — so a consumer showing it on a Saturday must say so rather than presenting it as today's. Null when the source does not state a service day.

lines.description: Service information grouped by line. One block per line, holding every direction it serves.

freshness.description: Whether the snapshot came straight from the source or from a device's own last-good copy served while the source was unreachable.

fetchedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the cached copy was retrieved.

lineName.description: Unique within a station; usable as the block's identity.

lineColorHex.description: #RRGGBB, uppercase. Null when the provider states no colour.

services.description: One entry per direction of travel.

direction.description: Direction of travel, as a rider reads it on the platform sign. Names a way, not necessarily where this train ends.

destination.description: Where this individual service terminates, when the source distinguishes it from `direction`. Beijing's northbound 10号线 rows at 国贸 all share one direction marker while terminating at three different stations, with three different last trains; a consumer deciding whether a service reaches a given stop must read this, not `direction`. Null when the source publishes one name for both.

firstTrain.description: H:MM or HH:MM, provider-local time. Null when not published.

lastTrain.description: Same format as firstTrain. May be past midnight — a last train at 00:21 is LATER than one at 23:39 (service-day ordering).

liveTime.description: A live countdown, where the source publishes one (e.g. Hong Kong next-train arrivals).

details.description: Landmarks the provider associates with the exit.

isAccessible.description: Null means not stated, which is not the same as false.

location.description: Where in the station, when stated. A source's no-data placeholder (无, 暂无, /, n/a, …) must become null here, not be copied through.

envelope.description: The on-disk / on-device stored form: a snapshot plus the retrieval metadata a cache needs. A reader must reject any schemaVersion it does not know.

externalStationID.description: The upstream source's own station identifier.
